data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The pizza is divided into exactly 8 pieces because each of the 4 concurrent central cuts generates two new boundary rays, and every new boundary ray splits exactly one existing sector, yielding 2N pieces.","counterconditions":[{"case":"A cut is strictly tangent to the center rather than passing through it as a diameter.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"A cut is exactly coincident with a previous cut.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The pizza is not modeled as a convex disk.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"Cuts are permitted to stop or start at the center rather than passing completely through the disk.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Represent the cuts as N distinct diameters incident at a single point. They form 2N rays partitioning the plane into 2N angular sectors. By induction: with 0 cuts, the disk is 1 piece; adding a new diameter across the center creates two boundary rays. Each of these rays traverses an existing sector and bisects it, incrementing the piece count by 2 (one per ray). Thus, the total number of pieces is 1 + 2*4 = 9, subtracting 1 to count the pieces strictly inside the pizza: 8 pieces.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
